current_status.partner: None disclosed for the semaglutide asset specifically; company is actively seeking a development/commercialization partner
current_status.data_point: NCT07563699 — dose-escalation Phase I/IIa study of Semaglutide Depot in type-2 diabetes, 24 participants, single site (Tel Aviv, Israel), est. primary completion May 2028

finding_history.summary: Mapi Pharma began patient recruitment for a Phase I/IIa, multicenter, open-label, dose-escalation study of 'Semaglutide Depot' in type-2 diabetes (NCT07563699). The trial evaluates safety, tolerability, PK, and efficacy of a monthly-injection long-acting semaglutide depot versus standard weekly dosing; 24-participant target enrollment, site in Tel Aviv, Israel, estimated primary completion May 2028. This directly resolves the prior 'possibly deprioritized' flag on this program — it is active and has just entered human dosing, not shelved.

In a press release announcing participation in ASCO and ADA 2026, Mapi Pharma listed its GLP-1 depot programs (semaglutide and tirzepatide) among pipeline programs and indicated the company was seeking partners for its semaglutide depot asset as one of the more advanced candidates in its long-acting depot portfolio. Note: subsequent 2026 Mapi press coverage (cariprazine depot Phase I/IIa results in August, glatiramer acetate depot MS data at AAN in April) did not mention the semaglutide program, consistent with a company that discloses assets selectively by conference rather than the program having been shelved — the August ClinicalTrials.gov listing (finding f-2026-08-09-001) confirms it remains active.
